title: Concept: TLS verification disabled in sample code
description: A code sample that disables certificate verification in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The sample is copied into production, where it turns every outbound HTTPS call into a connection that accepts any certificate, which defeats the transport guarantee entirely.
applicability: Developer documentation, SDK quick-start guides and support articles.
risk: Copied code with verification off accepts an attacker's certificate on every call to the payment or identity provider.
